context: Evaluates whether the agent spawns one investigator per category, honestly reports gaps from missing MCPs rather than anticipatory skipping, and produces a specific Sources Consulted map.

checklist.name: one_investigator_per_category
checklist.description: No category is merged into another investigator's scope; each investigator owns exactly one category.

checklist.name: gaps_named_not_skipped_by_anticipation
checklist.description: Every skipped category has a concrete justification (no MCP available, or provable irrelevance), never a bare assumption that it wouldn't have anything.

checklist.name: coverage_map_complete
checklist.description: All seven evidence categories are addressed in the output, each marked searched, empty, or skipped-with-reason.

checklist.name: sources_consulted_specific
checklist.description: The "Sources Consulted" section gives a specific, per-category account rather than a single vague sentence.
